narrative.intro: Gardaworld Federal Services shows $417M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Gardaworld Federal Services won 7 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $59.6M, and obligations are up 166.0% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $313M to Gardaworld Federal Services. The Department of State obligated $91M, and the Department of Defense obligated $12.8M. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services is the largest market for Gardaworld Federal Services at $313M, followed by Security Guards and Patrol Services at $104M. Historical annual obligations for Gardaworld Federal Services were $157M in FY21, $106M in FY23, $151M in FY24, $157M in FY25, and $417M in FY26. Gardaworld Federal Services recorded 7 awards in FY2026 to date, and current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values.

sections.heading: Who are Gardaworld Federal Services' top customers?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the top customer for Gardaworld Federal Services with $313M in obligations. The Department of State is the second-largest customer with $91M in obligations. The Department of Defense also buys from Gardaworld Federal Services, with $12.8M in obligations.

sections.heading: What markets and contract sizes drive Gardaworld Federal Services' federal business?
